prompt: Create a clean square academic diagram, white background, pale blue and muted teal boxes, thin dark arrows, readable English sans-serif text, flat 2D, calm minimal design, generous whitespace. No logos or numerical results. Title: Knowledge Transfer. Two separated horizontal lanes. Top lane titled Within one task: Accepted analysis -> Task knowledge access -> Implementation worker. Small labels under Accepted analysis: Obligations, API conditions, Mapping rationale. Under Task knowledge access: Report and original evidence. An additional top bypass arrow from Accepted analysis to Implementation worker labeled Required work-packet constraints. Bottom lane titled Across tasks: Reusable findings -> Shared library -> Next task snapshot. Label Shared library: Originals, Observations, Experience. Footer: Current retrieval is federated; unified finding index is planned. Keep arrows separated and readable.

Create a clean square academic diagram, white background, pale blue and muted teal boxes, thin dark arrows, readable English sans-serif text, flat 2D, calm minimal design, generous whitespace. No logos or numerical results. Title: Semantic Alignment. Top row three boxes connected left to right: Source obligation -> Target responsibility -> Implementation goal. Under Source obligation: Trigger and required outcome. Under Target responsibility: Driver, framework, caller. Under Implementation goal: One complete work package. Middle small box Necessary premises points upward to Target responsibility. Under Necessary premises: Source definitions or focused observations. Bottom row two boxes: Bounded source argument and Observed public scenarios, both receive arrows from Implementation goal. Footer: Traceability is not proof of complete equivalence. No theorem-prover icons.

Create a clean square academic diagram, white background, pale blue and muted teal boxes, thin dark arrows, readable English sans-serif text, flat 2D, calm minimal design, generous whitespace. No logos or numerical results. Title: Local Revision. Two rows of three aligned work-package boxes. Top row label Before: B1 Completed, B2 Current goal, B3 Independent. Bottom row label After: B1 Preserved, B2 Adapt locally, B3 Preserved. Thin vertical arrows connect each corresponding box. Only the central arrow is amber, labeled Concrete counterevidence. B2 bottom box is pale amber; others pale blue. Beneath these rows one wide box: Complete public suite on the final candidate. Bottom note: Preserve unrelated progress. Check explicit dependencies. This is an example with independent B3, not a guarantee every other package is unaffected.

Create a clean square academic diagram, white background, pale blue and muted teal boxes, thin dark arrows, readable English sans-serif text, flat 2D, calm minimal design, generous whitespace. No logos or numerical results. Title: Knowledge Ablations. Subtitle: Proposed study, not results. Four cards stacked vertically with concise labels: K0 Report handoff; K1 Add original-source retrieval; K2 Add analysis-finding retrieval; K3 Add frozen cross-task experience. Thin arrows downward show configurations with added capabilities. Separate side column labeled Shared conditions: Same model, Complete source, Same analysis report, Same obligations, Same tests. Bottom box labeled Measure: Repeated investigation, Correct knowledge adoption, Residual defects, Total cost. No values, plots, winning method, or green pass badges.
